merge_contents_evidence.choice: Evidence stays on the work branch
merge_contents_evidence.meaning: experiments/name-handling evidence, docs/work/name-handling working records and docs/design/analysis/name-resolution-proofs validation output are not carried into rust; the PR to rust carries product source, design docs and needed test fixtures only.

merge_contents_test_fixtures.choice: Review fixtures for performance, completeness and overlap; reduce in number where possible
merge_contents_test_fixtures.meaning: Test fixtures added on work (about 27,000 files, mostly rust/tcl-registry/tests/data, runtime/rust/tests/data, rust/tcl-syntax/tests/data) are reviewed before the PR: measure their test cost, confirm each covers a distinct behaviour, merge overlapping cases, and reduce file count without losing coverage.
